shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, menus, screens, cups, clothes or bags.
shared_prompts.safe_center: Keep the people and the thing that carries the meaning inside the central 55 percent of the photo width, so a centered 4:5 crop keeps them whole; only expendable background reaches the left and right edges.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.pair: Only these two people are in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.store: The camera stands on the sidewalk across from the shop and looks straight at its whole front: the door and the big shop window are clearly visible. The shop has NO sign, no name and no writing anywhere; what it is must be obvious only from what fills the window.
shared_prompts.nobody: There are no people anywhere in the photo.

assets.item: He's at the bookstore. / Is there a bookstore near here?
assets.prompt: An old man with a white beard and a flat cap stands on the sidewalk in front of a small bookstore and looks at the books in its big window, which is full of colorful books with plain covers.

assets.item: She takes the subway to work.
assets.prompt: A young woman in a grey office suit with a short black bob sits inside a modern subway train car with a laptop bag on her lap; through the windows behind her is a dark underground tunnel wall. Two other passengers sit far away, small and out of focus.

assets.item: He's going to the bakery to buy bread.
assets.prompt: Inside a small bakery a teenage boy with red hair and a green hoodie takes a paper bag with a long loaf of bread from a smiling female baker in a white apron across the counter; shelves of bread fill the wall.

assets.item: The train leaves from platform nine.
assets.prompt: An older couple with grey hair, each pulling a red suitcase, stand on a train platform beside a waiting blue train with open doors. Above them hangs one big square dark-blue sign with one huge white number: 9. The number is upright, sharp and easy to read even on a small phone screen; the train has no markings.

By the open front door of a bright home, a mother with curly brown hair holds out a small yellow backpack to her daughter of about nine, who reaches for it; the girl wears a raincoat and is ready to leave. Both faces show.

assets.item: The gas station is on the corner.
assets.prompt: A small gas station on the corner of a crossroads: two streets meet with a white zebra crosswalk on each, and the gas station (a flat white roof over two pumps with blank displays and one blue car) sits exactly on the corner between them, seen from across the crossroads.

assets.item: Turn left at the police station.
assets.prompt: The person is an older woman with short white hair in a red coat. On the LEFT corner of the crossroads is a red-brick police station with a plain white police car with a blue-and-red light bar parked in front, the car showing NO word; the right corner is a plain grey office building. The woman points her LEFT arm straight out to the left, along the side street past the police station. Nobody else is in the photo.

A man of about forty with a shaved head and a blue jacket walks a brown dog across a short wooden footbridge over a calm river, seen from the riverbank close by and from the side; he is large in the photo, in the middle of the bridge, and the water is clearly visible under it.

A teenage girl in a striped swimsuit and shorts holding a beach towel stands on the sand of a quiet beach by the sea beside a sign whose pictogram is a black swimming person in waves, crossed out by the red bar; she looks at the sign, disappointed. The girl and the sign are both large in the middle.

A young man's hand holds up one plain cream paper train ticket in front of a blurred station hall; the ticket has NO letters or numbers, only one big black two-way arrow, a straight line with an arrowhead at BOTH ends. The hand and ticket fill the middle of the photo.

Three adults wait at a city bus stop shelter with an empty road beside it and no bus anywhere; a man in a suit looks at his wristwatch with an annoyed face and a woman with a stroller looks down the empty road. It is plain that the bus is late.

At the wooden front desk of a small hotel a smiling female receptionist with a dark braid and a navy blazer holds out one brass room key on a wooden tag to an old man with a white moustache and a grey suitcase, who reaches for it; both faces show. No signs or numbers anywhere.
